articles.headline: Inaugural Northern Metropolis Marathon Draws 15,000 Runners Despite Heat
articles.summary_html:
The inauguralhappening for the first time; marking a beginning首次舉辦的 Northern Metropolis Marathon, organised by the Heung Yee Kuk to mark its 100th anniversary, drew around 15,000 runners on Sunday across full marathon, half marathon, 10-kilometre and 1,600-metre events. The full marathon set off at 6:30am from Shek Mun in Sha Tin, sending competitors past the Hong Kong Science Park, along the Tolo Highway and beside the Lam Tsuen River in Tai Po, before they finished on the newly commissionedofficially brought into operational use啟用 Fanling Bypass — a route designed to showcase the Northern Metropolis, a flagship development zone stretching along the border with Shenzhen.

The event proved gruellingextremely tiring and demanding艱辛的 for many participants, as temperatures climbed to around 28 degrees Celsius under a cloudless sky. Several finishers complained that water stations along the course were too few and too far apart, leaving some runners dehydrated in the sweltering heat. Ahead of race day, organisers had also stepped up patrols for stray dogs along the route, a precautionan action taken in advance to prevent harm預防措施 taken after two fatal dog maulingsviolent attacks that cause serious injury咬傷襲擊 in the New Territories earlier this year had raised safety concerns about holding such a large outdoor event so close to rural farmland.

Hong Kong runners sweptwon every or nearly every category in a competition囊括 nearly every category, losing out only in the men’s half marathon to a mainland competitor, and every finisher received a HK$50 voucher intended to stimulateencourage or increase activity刺激 spending at local businesses in the Northern Metropolis area. Acknowledging the criticism over the heat, organisers pledged to hold future editions in cooler months and floated ambitions to eventually extend the route across the border, positioning the race as a long-term cross-boundaryspanning or crossing an official border跨境的 fixture that could grow alongside the Northern Metropolis as it gradually takes shape over the coming decade.
articles.summary_zh_html:
由鄉議局主辦、以紀念該局成立100周年的首屆北部都會區馬拉松,週日吸引約15,000名跑手參與,項目包括全程馬拉松、半馬拉松、10公里及1,600米賽事。全馬賽事於早上6時30分在沙田石門起步,沿途經過香港科學園、吐露港公路及大埔林村河畔,終點設於剛啟用的粉嶺繞道——這條路線旨在展示北部都會區,一個沿深港邊境發展的旗艦發展區。

這場賽事對不少參賽者而言十分艱辛,當日氣溫在萬里無雲下升至約攝氏28度。多名完成賽事的跑手投訴,沿途水站數量太少、距離太疏,令部分跑手在酷熱天氣下出現脫水情況。賽前,主辦單位亦已加強在沿途巡邏、防範流浪犬,此預防措施是在新界早前發生兩宗致命狗隻咬傷襲擊事件後採取,事件引起外界對在鄰近農地舉行如此大型戶外活動的安全疑慮。

香港跑手幾乎囊括所有組別獎項,僅在男子半馬拉松項目中不敵一名內地跑手,而每位完成賽事的跑手均獲得一張50港元現金券,旨在刺激北部都會區內本地商戶的消費。面對外界對酷熱天氣的批評,主辦單位承諾日後將在較清涼的月份舉行賽事,並透露有意日後將路線延伸過境,定位這項賽事為一項長遠的跨境賽事盛事,期望隨着北部都會區於未來十年逐步成形而同步發展。

articles.headline: Study Expo Draws 5,000 Visitors as More Students Choose to Stay in Hong Kong
articles.summary_html:
Close to 5,000 parents and students attended the “Higher Education Expo 2026,” organised by Mingpao at the Kowloon Shangri-La on Saturday, where about 30 local and overseas institutions set up boothsexhibition stalls set up to display information or promote something攤位 to field questions about admission requirements. The free, day-long event also offered talks on JUPAS subject selection and overseas study planning, aimed at Form Four to Form Six pupils weighing their options ahead of next year’s HKDSE.

Education consultants at the fair said a growing number of families are opting to stay local, pointing to the soaringrising very quickly to a high level飆升的 cost of tuition and living abroad as well as the steady climb of Hong Kong universities up global rankings in recent years. One consultant described studying locally as an increasingly viableable to work successfully; a realistic option可行的 alternative that no longer carries the stigmaa feeling of shame or social disapproval attached to something污名 it once did, while another noted that rising fees abroad have become a genuine deterrentsomething that discourages a particular action阻嚇因素 for middle-income households.

Even so, many visitors remained set on sending their children abroad. A consultant specialising in UK admissions said medicine and health sciences were by far the most sought-after subjects, since graduates there can obtain professional credentialsofficial qualifications proving competence專業資格 directly upon completing their degree, without the extra licensing hurdles some other systems require. Exhibitors said the mixed turnoutthe number of people who attend an event出席人數 — some chasing overseas prestige, others persuaded by Hong Kong’s rising profile — reflected a student population weighing cost, prestige and career pragmatisma practical approach based on results rather than ideals實用主義 more carefully than ever before.
articles.summary_zh_html:
由《明報》主辦的「2026升學博覽」週六假九龍香格里拉酒店舉行,吸引接近5,000名家長及學生到場,約30間本地及海外院校設置攤位,解答參觀者有關入學要求的問題。這項免費、全日舉行的活動亦設有講座,內容涵蓋JUPAS選科及海外升學規劃,主要對象為正就升學路向作抉擇、準備應考明年文憑試的中四至中六學生。

多名在場的升學顧問表示,愈來愈多家庭選擇留港升學,原因包括海外學費及生活費飆升,以及本港大學近年在全球排名持續攀升。有顧問形容,留港升學已成為日益可行的選擇,不再像以往般帶有污名;另有顧問指出,海外學費上漲已成為中等收入家庭真正的阻嚇因素。

即使如此,不少參觀者仍堅持安排子女出國留學。一名專責英國升學事務的顧問表示,醫學及健康科學是最受歡迎的學科,因為畢業生完成課程後,即可直接取得專業資格,不必像其他制度般再經額外的執業認證程序。多間參展機構均表示,這次活動的出席人數反映出多元取向——部分人追求海外聲望,部分人則因本港學府地位上升而受吸引——反映本港學生在成本、聲望與職業實用主義之間,考慮得比以往更為周全。

articles.headline: Hong Kong Logs Warmest October in 142 Years, Cooler Air on the Way
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong has just recorded its hottest October since records began 142 years ago, the Observatory confirmed this week, with the average daily maximum reaching 30.5 degrees Celsius and the monthly mean climbing to 27.6 degrees — both unprecedentednever having happened or existed before前所未有的 for the month. The spell of unusually warm weather culminatedreached its highest point or climax達到頂點 in the latest-ever issuance of a Very Hot Weather Warning, triggered when temperatures in Yuen Long hit 36 degrees in mid-October, long after such extremes would typically have faded for the year.

Meteorologists attributed the prolonged heat to a confluencea coming together of several things at once匯聚 of factors: the broader warming trend driven by climate change, an active El Niño pattern, a weaker-than-usual northeast monsoon, and a stubborn high-pressure system anchoredfixed firmly in one place盤踞 over southern China that suppressed rain and kept skies clear. Taken together, these conditions compoundedmade a problem or effect worse by adding to it使情況加劇 one another, allowing summer-like heat to persist deep into what is normally one of the city’s most comfortable months.

Relief now appears to be on the way. The Observatory expects a strengthening northeast monsoon to usher into cause something new to begin帶來 markedly drier, cooler air from next Monday, when the urban minimum is forecast to dip to 23 degrees, falling further to 22 degrees the following day and to as low as 19 degrees in parts of the New Territories. Forecasters cautioned, however, that the abruptnessthe quality of happening suddenly and unexpectedly突然性 of the transition — from near-record heat to autumn chill within days — illustrates just how volatileliable to change suddenly and unpredictably反覆無常的 Hong Kong’s weather patterns have become amid a changing climate.
articles.summary_zh_html:
天文台本週確認,香港剛錄得142年來最熾熱的10月,月內平均每日最高氣溫達攝氏30.5度,月平均氣溫亦升至27.6度,兩者均屬該月前所未有的紀錄。這股異常酷熱的天氣,達到頂點之際,更觸發歷來最遲發出的酷熱天氣警告,原因是元朗氣溫於10月中一度飆升至36度,遠超該類極端天氣通常在年內持續的時間。

氣象學家指出,持續高溫由多項因素匯聚造成:氣候變化帶動的整體升溫趨勢、活躍的厄爾尼諾現象、較正常偏弱的東北季候風,以及一個盤踞華南上空、抑制降雨並令天空持續晴朗的頑固高壓系統。這些因素互相使情況加劇,令本應是全年最舒適月份之一的10月,持續出現如夏季般的酷熱天氣。

紓緩天氣終於有望來臨。天文台預計,一股增強的東北季候風將於下週一帶來明顯更乾燥及涼爽的空氣,當日市區最低氣溫預料跌至23度,翌日再跌至22度,部分新界地區更可能低見19度。然而,預報員提醒,這次由接近破紀錄高溫急轉直下至初秋涼意的突然性轉變,正好說明在氣候變化下,香港的天氣模式已變得何等反覆無常。

articles.headline: Survey Finds Severe Underemployment in Hong Kong's Construction Sector
articles.summary_html:
A new survey of more than 1,000 frontline construction workers has laid barerevealed clearly, exposing something hidden揭露 the extent of underemployment grippingaffecting strongly and persistently困擾著 Hong Kong’s building trade, with roughly half of respondents reporting that their wages had stayed flat over the past year and around 40 per cent saying they had actually taken a pay cut. The Hong Kong Construction Industry Employees General Union, which conducted the survey between August and September, said close to 70 per cent of workers reported earning less than the wage levels it officially publishes for each trade — a gap the union called glaringvery obvious and impossible to ignore顯而易見的 evidence that published rates have become largely symbolicrepresenting something rather than having real practical effect象徵性的.

Wages for 15 major construction trades will remain frozen for the 2026/27 financial year, the union confirmed, with marble workers the sole exception: their daily rate will rise by HK$100 to HK$1,600 from November 1. The union attributed the broader wage stagnationa lack of growth or development停滯 to a marked slowdown in infrastructure projects, arguing that fewer new sites have left a swellinggrowing larger in number or size不斷膨脹的 pool of workers competing for a shrinking number of shifts, driving down bargaining power across almost every trade.

In response, the union has called on the government to set up an interdepartmental mechanism that would more effectively match idlenot working; inactive閒置的 construction workers with available vacancies, rather than leaving job-matching largely to informal networks and subcontractors. Labour representatives warned that without intervention, the mismatcha lack of correspondence between two things錯配 between a workforce trained for a booming housing pipeline and a market now offering far fewer projects could deepen further, pushing experienced tradespeople toward early retirement or out of the industry altogether.

一項訪問超過1,000名建築業前線工人的調查,揭露了困擾著本港建築行業、程度嚴重的就業不足問題:約一半受訪者表示,過去一年工資維持不變,另有約四成人表示工資實際遭削減。負責調查的香港建造業僱員總會於8月至9月期間進行訪問,指出近七成工人表示實際所得低於工會公布的各工種工資水平——工會形容,這是公布工資水平已淪為顯而易見且象徵性數字的證據。

工會確認,15個主要建築工種的工資將於2026/27財政年度維持凍結,石工為唯一例外,其日薪將由11月1日起上調100港元至1,600港元。工會將這種普遍的工資停滯歸因於基建工程明顯減少,認為新工程項目減少,令不斷膨脹的工人人數爭奪愈來愈少的開工機會,拖低幾乎每個工種的議價能力。

trends.headline: 🎰💸 HK$80 Million Mark Six Jackpot Goes Unclaimed — Because of One Split Bet
trends.summary_html:
Hong Kong’s Halloween-night Mark Six draw ended with an HK$80 million jackpot going unclaimed, but it was a losing ticket, not the missing winner, that set social media ablazefull of excitement or intense activity熱議沸騰. A woman posted on Threads that she had matched all six winning numbers — yet walked away with just HK$80, because she had split the combination across two separate single bets rather than buying one combined ticket covering all six numbers together.

Mark Six pays out strictly per individual bet entry, so her near-perfect pick unravelledcame apart or fell apart, failing to hold together化為 into two smaller, low-value prizes instead of the jackpot. The post quickly went viralspreading very quickly online among many people瘋傳, drawing thousands of reactions split between sympathy and mockeryridicule or teasing of someone嘲笑; many pointed out that the odds of matching all six numbers are roughly one in 14 million, so even her consolationsomething that offers comfort after a disappointment安慰性的 prize was, statistically, a minor miracle. Others used the story to ventto express strong feelings, especially frustration發洩 about how confusing lottery rules can be.
trends.summary_zh_html:
香港萬聖節夜舉行的六合彩攪珠,頭獎8,000萬港元無人中,但真正令社交媒體熱議沸騰的,並非那個無人領取的頭獎,而是一張「失敗」的彩票。一名女生在Threads發文,表示自己六個號碼全部命中——卻只換來80港元,原因是她將號碼組合分拆於兩張獨立的單式彩票下注,而非合併為一張涵蓋全部六個號碼的彩票。

六合彩的派彩方式,是嚴格按每注獨立計算,因此她近乎完美的選號,最終化為兩個金額較小的獎項,而非頭獎。這則帖文迅速瘋傳,引來大量網民反應,夾雜同情與嘲笑;不少人指出,六個號碼全中的機率約為1,400萬分之一,因此即使是她那份安慰性的獎金,統計上也算是個小奇蹟。亦有人借這宗事件,發洩對六合彩規則令人費解的不滿。

causes.label: Confusion over how Mark Six payouts actually work
causes.label_zh: 對六合彩派彩機制的誤解
causes.text: Much of the viral reaction assumed the woman had simply been cheated, when in fact Mark Six pays out strictly per individual bet entry rather than by pooling numbers across separate tickets. The episode shows how easily financial rules can be misunderstood and reshared inaccurately once a story goes viral, with even well-meaning commentators spreading confident but wrong explanations.
causes.text_zh: 大部分網民的即時反應,都假設這名女生單純被騙,但事實上六合彩的派彩機制,是嚴格按每注獨立計算,而非將分開購買的注項號碼合併計算。這宗事件說明,一項財務規則一旦隨着帖子瘋傳,便容易被誤解並以錯誤方式廣泛轉載,甚至連出於好意的網民,亦會自信滿滿地散播錯誤解釋。

causes.label: Lottery literacy as a hidden financial-literacy gap
causes.label_zh: 六合彩知識反映隱性財務知識缺口
causes.text: The woman's mistake — splitting six numbers across separate single-combination bets instead of one combined entry — reflects a wider gap in how clearly betting mechanics are explained to casual players. For a game that generates such enormous public interest, critics argue more should be done to ensure ordinary punters actually understand the rules before they place a bet.
causes.text_zh: 這名女生的錯誤——將六個號碼分散下注於多張獨立單式彩票,而非合併為一張複式彩票——反映出普羅投注者對投注機制的理解,存在更廣泛的缺口。對於一項引起如此龐大公眾興趣的博彩遊戲,批評者認為,當局應做得更多,確保一般彩民在下注前,真正理解相關規則。

causes.label: Scrutiny over how the Jockey Club explains its payout rules
causes.label_zh: 外界對馬會派彩規則透明度的檢視
causes.text: The incident has renewed calls for the Hong Kong Jockey Club to publicise its payout structure more plainly, including clear examples of how splitting a six-number combination across multiple tickets affects a player's actual odds. Supporters of tighter disclosure argue that a monopoly operator running a game this popular bears a special responsibility to make its rules unmistakable.
causes.text_zh: 這次事件,再次引來要求香港賽馬會更清晰公開其派彩架構的呼聲,包括清楚說明將六個號碼分拆在多張彩票下注,會如何影響玩家的實際中獎機率。支持加強披露的人士認為,一家壟斷經營如此受歡迎博彩遊戲的機構,肩負特別責任,確保其規則清晰明確,不留誤解空間。

causes.label: Viral mockery overshadows the deeper issue of gambling hardship
causes.label_zh: 網絡嘲弄掩蓋博彩背後更深層的困境
causes.text: Not everyone welcomed the lighthearted mockery that followed. Some commentators argued that treating the story mainly as an amusing cautionary tale distracts from the more serious reality that many Hongkongers spend far more on lottery tickets than they can comfortably afford, chasing a jackpot that mathematically almost never arrives.
causes.text_zh: 並非所有人都認同隨後出現的輕鬆嘲弄。有評論認為,將這宗事件主要當作一則有趣的警世故事來看待,反而掩蓋了更嚴重的現實——不少香港人花在彩票上的金錢,遠超他們所能負擔,只為追逐一個數學上幾乎永遠不會降臨的頭獎。
